description: React component for displaying top keys with chart and table views, including modal for key info details.

classes.name: TopKeyView
classes.description: React functional component for visualizing top keys with optional tags, chart/table toggle, and modal for detailed info.

methods.name: toggleTagsExpansion
methods.description: Toggles expansion of tags for a specific API key.

methods.name: handleKeyClick
methods.description: Fetches detailed key info and opens modal when a key is clicked.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the modal and resets related state.

methods.name: handleOutsideClick
methods.description: Closes modal if click occurs outside modal content.
